THE STRATEGIC DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS ACT, No. 14 OF 2008

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Sub-Section (4) of Section 3 of the Strategic Development Project Act, No. 14 of 2008as amended, I, Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, being the Minister inCharge of the subject of Investment Promotion, further to the Order published under Sub section (4) of Section 3 underGazette Extraordinary No. 1867/5 dated 16th June, 2014 do by this Order declare that,
Clause (4) of the Order published under Gazette Extraordinary No. 1867/5 dated 16th June, 2014 is herebyamended to read as follows in order to extend the time granted to implement the Project :-
“(4) The aforesaid Project shall commence commercial operations within ninety (90) months from the date stated inthe Project Agreement with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka”.
MALIK SAMARAWICKRAMA,Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade.
